elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least $2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Where HDI processes the Company's Confidential Information or user data, it must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least $5,000,000, covering the customer-data processing condition.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: HDI must provide the Company with certificates of insurance upon request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required $2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the $1,000,000 fallback threshold.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cyber and privacy obligation is conditional on HDI processing the Company's Confidential Information or user data; the fallback element states an unconditional coverage requirement.
